authors: Claude Opus 5.5 (l1c1-cost protocol lane; written before any data)
status_note: Frozen by the commit that first adds this file at this path. No data existed when it was written. Runner: a separate session, run.sh only, after drand round R >= freeze + 1 h.
question: On fresh p1009 targets and identical descent streams, does L1 (accepting (1^4,2), (1^2,2^2), (2^3) solutions whose quadratic classes are in D_exact) reduce the actual cost of descent to K = 2 verified successes, does C1 (F4 trace replay), and do they compose multiplicatively?

claims.text: L1 main effect on counted descent cost to K: R_L1 = sum C_l1 / sum C_base with 95% cluster-bootstrap interval; verdict per decision_rule
C1 main effect: R_C1 = sum C_c1 / sum C_base
Interaction I = R_L1C1 / (R_L1 R_C1) and composition (S_C1|L1, S_L1|C1)
The same three on thread CPU time of the same window
Every accepted success passes group identity, anchor identity, affine path, certified projection and elliptic replay; counted matcher rows equal the audit rows

family.curve: jv_cover weak cover y^2 = x(x-alpha)(x-sigma alpha) over F_{q^3}, q = p^2
family.same_as: Run50 public.json and the l1-paired targets

nonce_scheme.command: fresh-scaling-gen nonce --protocol-sha256 H --commit C --drand-round R --drand-randomness X
nonce_scheme.H: sha256 of protocol.json at the freeze commit
nonce_scheme.C: first commit adding protocol.json at study_dir
nonce_scheme.R: first drand mainnet default-chain round (chain 8990e7a9aaed2ffed73dbd7092123d6f289930540d7651336225dc172e51b2ce, genesis 1595431050, period 30 s) with time >= freeze committer time + 3600 s
nonce_scheme.X: that round's randomness from api.drand.sh / api2.drand.sh / drand.cloudflare.com; round number checked
nonce_scheme.fallback: R = 0, X = freeze tree id; disclosed as grindable; recorded as drand_source=fallback:freeze-tree

targets.admission: fresh-scaling-gen check; check_unseen.py (git-tracked *public*.json, every line of git-tracked *publics*.jsonl incl. the 96 l1-paired targets, dry-run tarballs, earlier candidates; equal input or shared curve (p, alpha) refused); public transfer (exit 10 refused, not counted); exit 11 counts toward T with no rows
targets.pool: indices 0.. in order, first T + 16 then 16 at a time, cap 192
targets.planted: pilot-nonce --protocol-sha256 H, indices 0 and 1, PC2 only

arms.solver: traced (descent-finder traced_solver; one trace per process; fallback F4 on rejection, both charged)

arms.role: wall A/A repeat of base (own process, derived position)

pairing: all arms on the same target, collection, factor base, D_exact, certified quotient and residual stream; one process per arm

endpoint.definition: cost from stream start to the residual whose rank-raising accepted rows bring the arm's two-column affine system to rank 2, plus the two-column solve and [d]G = Q
endpoint.acceptance_order: residual order; within a residual (1^6) rows in decomposition order, then L1 rows in sorted-solution order
endpoint.censoring: base not at rank 2 by NCAP: cost to NCAP, reported; biases against L1

instrument.source: l1c1_cost.rs (audit section = l1_paired.rs lines 60-839 byte for byte + one marked insertion)
instrument.library: 11c9a031 deferred-pair modules over the Root41-equivalent fcda1e22 closure, nagao-e2e jv_cover overlay efc554a4..., assembled by ../l1-steps-2-3/build (unchanged) + build/overlay_counted.py

counted.label: counted lower bound
includes: Weil forms, F4 or replay, counted linear stage
C1 learning RREF at its upper bound (fp_mul + fp_add per multiply-add)

all L1 work: D_exact table, Weil forms, sextic, squarefree and DDF tests, equal-degree splitting, factor-base probes, ordinate checks, resultants, V, V^2 = H mod U, canonical key, D_exact probes, principal-divisor identity, anchor identity once per class per target, substituted row and projection
excludes: collection, linear algebra and the pipeline's own descent (shared)
unpriced: F4 replay bookkeeping beyond f4_fp hooks
symbolic preprocessing, hashing outside hooks, allocation, containers

wall.definition: thread CPU ns (/proc/thread-self/schedstat) of the same window; frozen build, hooks off; one process per arm; five processes per target in derived order
wall.label: INDICATIVE (non-isolated host)

statistics.interval: target-cluster percentile bootstrap, B = 20000, indices 500/19499 (95%) and 100/19899 (99%), SplitMix64 exact rejection sampling, seed l1c1-bootstrap

secondary: mean residuals to K per arm

order: INVALID (all) if any per-target gate, any control (pc1, pc1b, pc1c, pc2, dc, unseen) or the counted A/A fails
KILL-CORRECTNESS (L1) if replay_fail_M > 0; KILL-CORRECTNESS (C1) if a traced solution chain differs from the production audit; interaction and composition then KILL-CORRECTNESS
decision_rule.counted_aa: first 32 targets, independent stream: 99% intervals of sum C_base^aa / sum C_base and R_L1^aa / R_L1 contain 1
decision_rule.wall: same rules on W; wall A/A (sum W_base / sum W_base-aa, 99%) must contain 1 (else INVALID-WALL-AA) and lie within [0.95, 1.05] (else NO-WALL-VERDICT-NOISE-FLOOR); always labelled INDICATIVE
decision_rule.rho_distance: not computed: descent-phase component measurement, no leaderboard row (critic F3/F5)

controls.c1_correctness: per residual: solution chain equal to the production audit; accepted replays certified (not timed out, no pair above bound, 1 in J or staircase <= 64); rejected replay + fallback both charged; rejections reported

per_arm: production-checked rows equal the audit's rows up to tau, in order
d verified and equal to the pipeline's verified scalar
wall: tau, chain, accepted rows and scalar equal the counted arm's

variable_ledger.arm: 2x2 on shared state and stream; one process per arm
variable_ledger.instrument: one source, two builds differing only in zero_dim_la.rs; outputs build-independent (checked)
variable_ledger.order: counted arms deterministic; wall processes in a derived permutation of five
variable_ledger.host: shared, not isolated: wall INDICATIVE with an A/A noise-floor gate
variable_ledger.trace_state: one trace per process, learned on residual 0, RREF charged at its bound

blinding.note: costs are produced by the runner and read only by the frozen analysis program

sample_size.successes_per_arm: K = 2 per uncensored target (256 at T = 128; >= 100 at T >= 50)

stopping_rules: budget: before each target stop if spent + 1.5 x max target CPU > 8 h - 900 s; analyze completed targets with budget_truncated=1; T < 50 -> INCONCLUSIVE-UNDERPOWERED
PC1/PC1b/PC1c/PC2/DC failure: stop, no verdict, amendment required
no stop reads a cost, tau or ratio
invalidation_rules: any change to a file in SOURCES.sha256 after the freeze without a prior amendment
a re-run under the same nonce after any data were seen, except the DC rerun
targets not derived from the frozen nonce scheme
decisions taken from wall fields without the INDICATIVE label
inadmissible: multiplying l1-paired's acceptance gain by descent-walltime's ratios (critic F6)
calling the counted metric complete or conservative
ranking arms under section 5a from counted lower bounds
any rho distance or leaderboard row from this protocol

recording.after_data: results README with verdicts as printed; bench.record/v1 and research-visuals report in the results PR (not inputs to any verdict)
